text: Why? Same house!
America!
One million dollars!
France!
Thirty-five thousand dollars!
This is Doug! Doug want house!
In California, house cost one million dollars!
That is one hundred thousand fish!
In small French village, same house cost thirty-five thousand!
That is cheaper than new car!
Same walls! Same roof! Same three bedrooms! Why?
House price is not house! House price is jobs!
California have big jobs! Tech! Big paycheck!
Everybody want live near job!
Many animals! Few houses!
And rules say: build slow!
Ten animals fight for one house! Highest money win!
Price go up, up, up!
One million dollars!
French village have no jobs!
Young animals leave for big city!
Many houses! Nobody want!
Price go down, down, down!
Thirty-five thousand!
This is called supply and demand!
Doug poor.
In real life, house near Boussac, France: thirty-seven thousand euros!
California typical house: about nine hundred thousand dollars!
Doug buy French house! Doug happy!
Big garden! Fresh bread! Life is good!
Life is not good! Doug need job!
Nearest job: one hour drive! Every day! Two hours in car!
Then Larry the walrus buy California house!
Larry rent it to Doug! Every month!
Cheap house, no job! Big job, no house!
One million dollar house, or thirty-five thousand dollar village?
Tell Doug in the comments!
